system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an AWS Lambda function named 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue, written in Python 3.12.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Lambda function triggered by SQS queue'

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor
    Description: Name of the Lambda function

  SQSQueueName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor-queue
    Description: Name of the SQS queue

  LambdaExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: order-processor-lambda-role
    Description: Name of the Lambda execution role

Resources:
  # SQS Queue
  OrderProcessorQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Ref SQSQueueName
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Dead Letter Queue
  OrderProcessorDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${SQSQueueName}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref LambdaExecutionRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SQSQueueAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn

  # Lambda Function
  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              for record in event['Records']:
                  payload = json.loads(record['body'])
                  logger.info(f"Processing order: {payload}")
              return {'statusCode': 200}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderProcessorQueue

  # Event Source Mapping
  SQSEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      BatchSize: 10
      Enabled: true
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 0

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn

  SQSQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the SQS queue
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorQueue

  SQSQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorQueue.Arn
